copy.storyHeading: Eighteen years of fabricating in Klang
story: Batu & Besi opened its Kapar workshop in 2008 making security grilles. Awnings followed, then staircases, then the external works that kept coming up on the same jobs — driveways, drains, boundary walls.

Eighteen years on we still fabricate everything ourselves rather than buying in. It is why we can show you the beam sizing before you commit, and why our structural steelwork carries a ten-year warranty.

seo.homeDescription: Batu & Besi fabricates car porch awnings, security grilles, autogates, staircases and external works across Klang, Kapar and Setia Alam. Own workshop, 10-year structural warranty.
seo.aboutDescription: Batu & Besi is a metalwork and external works contractor in Klang, established 2008 — 24 fabricators and fitters with over 950 installations across the Klang Valley.
seo.portfolioDescription: Selected Batu & Besi projects: car porch awnings, autogates, glass balustrades, re-roofing, driveways and light industrial metalwork across Klang and Setia Alam.
seo.quoteDescription: Send us your span and site photos. Batu & Besi will size the steel and quote, including the load calculation behind the price.

process.title: Measure & Calculate
process.text: We site-measure and size the steel to the span and the load. Most awning failures around here are undersized beams, so we will show you the calculation rather than ask you to trust the quote.

process.title: Fabricate in Workshop
process.text: Everything is cut, welded and finished in our Klang workshop, not on your driveway. Welds are done properly under cover, and the finish is applied before anything reaches your house.

process.title: Install & Warrant
process.text: Installation usually takes one to three days with minimal mess. Structural steelwork carries a ten-year warranty; motors and moving parts carry the manufacturer's terms plus our first-year service.
